notes.notes:
Hi peeps, another day another bug squashed. Here are the changes:

Changelog:

Fixed - Xbox One controller bluetooth bug

Fixed - A specific toggle not properly working in an area in Chapter 3

Changed - SFX in a Chapter 1 map

notes.title: Hotfix Version 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Hi peeps! We fixed some of the recent bugs that you guys found. Here are the changes

Changelog:

Fixed - Walking in a specific underground area triggers an encounter every step

Fixed - Game state incorrectly changed during certain cutscene

Fixed - Invisible wall in Chapter 3 main area

Fixed - Potentially stuck progress in Chapter 2 Main Quest

Fixed - Potentially incorrect quest marker state in a Chapter 2 and Chapter 4 area

Fixed - Equipment menu state bug if rapidly pressing 'Accept' in main menu

Fixed - Empty hidden items in a Chapter 3 area

Optimized - Game logic that handles cutscene and encounter state

notes.notes:

Good day everyone! We heard your reports and already fixed some of the current found issue. Here are the changes.

Fixed - minimap wrong scale at certain resolutions

notes.title: Demo Update 2
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, this is a 2nd update and probably the last update to the demo. 

Some changes we did this time:
[olist]
Various bug fixing.
Random encounter now works in Hephaestus building.
Random encounter option now working.
Changed some cut scene to CG in order to better illustrate the situation in game. (The final game will also be CG in some cutscene)
[/olist]
Example: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36990047/d8839e6c1d6781b80dde0b7d482f647283bba37d.png



We're still working hard on the game, stay tuned for more info in the future.

And as usual if you find any other bugs, issue or just want to give feedback, you can do it at our discord https://discord.gg/VwuwTRp or at the steam discussion forum.

Thank you for trying out demo!

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, we have a QoL updates for the demo, here are the change logs

Change log:

 Able to skip prologue cutscene.
 Added more npc dialogues inside Athena HQ.
 Fixed controller issue not be able to open chest or interact with NPC.
 Fixed DS4 sliding movement issue.
 Added more vfx to the city map. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36990047/033aa323e180e843b58cb9f9563d79251108a660.png


Known issue:

 Since we added npc dialogues that changes over time, we had to change the save system to make it persistent. It is advised to start a new game in order to avoid bugs. Save location is at : "C:\Users\USERNAME\AppData\Roaming\Godot\app_userdata\Fractured Core\save.dat" Replace USERNAME with your windows username.
 The encounter rate option doesn't work, this is intentional as the demo doesn't contain any random encounter yet. It will be added in the final game.


If you find any other bugs, issue or just want to give feedback, you can do it at our discord https://discord.gg/VwuwTRp or at the steam discussion forum.

Thank you for trying our demo!
